roleContext.jobDescription: The building services business operates heating, cooling and lighting systems for commercial landlords under energy performance contracts. The Energy Analytics Analyst analyses the buildings' metered energy data, identifies savings measures with their expected savings, prepares the monthly performance report for each landlord, monitors the contracted savings against the baseline, and documents each measure's boundaries. Measure approvals and contract commitments stay with the account director. Reports to the head of energy analytics; works with the site engineers, the account directors and the landlords' facilities managers.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Energy Analytics Analyst, Building Services

## Experience

- Energy analytics analyst at a building services company for three years, analysing the metered energy data of twenty-four commercial buildings under the team's analysis procedure and identifying savings measures with their expected savings.
- Prepared the monthly performance report for each landlord under the energy performance contracts, with the reports accepted by the landlords' facilities managers.
- Monitored the contracted savings against the baseline each month and raised two shortfalls to the account director concerned, recorded in the savings register.
- Coordinated the measure proposals with the site engineers through the measure log; the measure approvals and the contract commitments were the account director's, recorded on each proposal, and the log records which analyses were mine.
- Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each measure proposal for the site engineers.

## Work samples

- Work sample: one monthly performance report, two measure proposals with their approval records and the savings register extract for one quarter, with the energy data platform references as a verification trail.
